headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning 10-5 behind Jake Mangum's standout performance. Mangum collected 4 hits, including a home run, and drove in 3 runs. The New York Mets also secured a win, taking down the Kansas City Royals 7-3 with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Zack Gelof, the Athletics' third baseman, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right knee laceration. Mark Vientos, the New York Mets' first baseman, has also been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hand fracture. Other teams have also suffered injuries, including the Washington Nationals, Cincinnati Reds, Philadelphia Phillies, Miami Marlins, and Washington Nationals.

The New York Mets bolstered their bullpen with a trade acquisition, bringing in right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash. The Detroit Tigers also traded right-handed pitcher Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded right-handed pitcher Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash, while the Houston Astros traded left-handed pitcher Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Past Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a decisive victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, winning the game 10-5. Jake Mangum led the Braves' offense with a standout performance, collecting 4 hits, including a home run, and driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Sean Manaea earning the win after 7.0 innings pitched. Tyrone Taylor led the Royals' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Juan Soto's 21st homer of the season was a key play for the Mets.

top_news.title: **Yankees Rout Rays 12-4**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees dominated the Tampa Bay Rays, securing a 12-4 victory. Ben Rice led the Yankees' offense with 2 home runs and 5 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Fall Short in Baltimore**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dropped a close game to the Baltimore Orioles, losing 2-3. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Athletics Place Zack Gelof on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics third baseman Zack Gelof has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right knee laceration. The injury occurred on an unspecified date.

top_news.title: **Mets Bolster Bullpen with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers in exchange for cash.
